aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource needs the permissions installed by aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy before the export can validate or use its S3 destination. Its bucket reference waits only for bucket creation, allowing export setup to race with the policy granting bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com s3:GetBucketPolicy and s3:PutObject. Add an explicit dependency on the bucket policy.
